rules.evidence: 2 every-turn file(s) under declared budgets
planning files declared in roadkeep.toml, and a PreToolUse guard is wired
11 commit(s) add several ledger entries, e.g. 59230344, 2d6ca3ab, 5657be7b
3 instruction file(s) scanned, no piped gate
on push: gate.yml, gui-site.yml, gui.yml, site.yml
line terminators declared in .gitattributes
Only the /help description of the four commands/*.md bodies is capped at 60 characters; no test or budget caps the bodies an agent receives, and [reads] caps only the brief, list and show responses.
The names test checks only the hand-typed _MUST_NAME tuple, so a wrong write-tool name in skills/roadkeep/writing.md:17-24 would pass every gate.
The job installs the pinned CLAUDE_VERSION 2.1.220 and runs tests/test_plugin.py against the tree as the plugin loader reads it.
Shio is named as the reference adoption with counted facts, and tests/corpora.py pins its revision.
The README says the twelve MCP tools while serving.TOOLS holds 71 at this commit, and no test reads that sentence.
[limits], [non_goals] and [criteria] declare widths that the write path refuses.
The declared prose-shape rules are held by tests that read the governed prose.
Filing Block J (9ecfa187) turned the suite red and bb40b38c fixed it later, so RK1690 was committed on a red tree.
The default commit route stages everything, while the same skill says parallel sessions share this checkout.
A docs commit writing ledger, decision, rationale and roadmap entries has a diff-generated title with no task id; 4473b6eb and 9a90f81a have the same shape.
Each open line names a fault or a missing capability.
No commit rule says whether commits carry attribution, and d71c1625 and cdf09ac9 carry a Co-Authored-By trailer.
The skill requires claim with --path, and claim reads the scope back against the tree.
The prescribed stager adds every path in a checkout parallel sessions share, so it stages outside the claim.
The hook derives the bump from the committed version and stages only the version files.
Tests whose tree moved under the run skip with a warning instead of passing or failing.
Whether a cited count was taken while another session had uncommitted work cannot be read from the repository.
The committed .mcp.json declares the checkout's own scripts/roadkeep.py as the server that answers.
subprocess.run with text=True and no encoding decodes a child's output with the locale codec; scripts/like_ci.py does the same.
One leading U+FEFF is stripped from piped stdin.
The order in which past encoding defects were diagnosed is not recorded in a checkable form.
Heredoc edits are forbidden and the only incident predates the rule.
The heredoc rule was seen broken (RK1091) and stays prose only: no deny rule, and the guard does not refuse it.
The guarded rule is also checked by roadkeep lint in CI.
The PreToolUse matcher leaves out the PowerShell tool, which can write a governed file on the Windows machine this project runs on.
When no engine runs, the guard returns 0 and writes nothing, so the session is not told it is unguarded.
The hook wiring and manifest are held by tests that run in CI.
Lint reports install.stale and install.absent for a copy behind its source.
Lines waiting on a person carry (requires: decision) and stay open.
When the weighing test went red, the agent lowered its own margin from 1.5 to 1.2 with no bar set by a person.
Open lines lead with the observed symptom.
Falsified premises are recorded in place with the reason.
Ship entries carry design-recorded-in pointers, and decisions go to DECISIONS.md.
Blocks carry done-when criteria, and permanent headings keep an emptied block from reading as closed.
Waiting lines carry the requirement with its declared reason.
This committed settings file carries allow rules, and nothing in gui/ names the guard or gate that stands in for the removed prompts.
Heredoc edits are forbidden only in prose; no deny or ask rule and no guard refuses them.
No tracked file has a credential-like name.
RK1690 was recorded as shipped while the suite was red from filing Block J, with no red-suite exception.
The corpus round-trip cases skip in CI and the job reports success, so checks that did not execute count toward a green run.
The test gate is a bare pytest run, and nothing compares the tests collected with the tests that reported a result.
The recorded red from an outside cause was answered by narrowing the tests, not by rerunning.
No gate is recorded as kept red while other work continued.
A behaviour change was recorded as shipped though the commit changes only settings and docs and no gate covers it.
Each ceiling raise cites a reading taken before the change.
The every-turn file holds the laws and a layout index, and points to trigger-loaded skills.
Skill descriptions name occasions and trigger words, held by a test.
This 5,990-byte trigger-loaded body has no ceiling in [budgets] or in the skill tests.
The list given as the whole write path leaves out served write tools, and no test checks it against serving.TOOLS.
Per-tool and session ceilings on served schemas are enforced by lint.
